messages:
alex: Heads-up — noticed a weird step in p95 for /v1/generate after the route-merge at 08:12 UTC. p50 and p99 look fine, sample counts unchanged. Anyone seen this? :thinking:

maria: @alex can you paste the p95 query you used? quick guess: merge mode might be pulling in a slower shard under certain quotas.

alex: here: ```promql
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_latency_bucket{route='/v1/generate'}[5m])) by (le,route,shard))
```

kevin: if you include `fallback_variant` tag it might show a pattern. we recently adjusted routing weights for low-tier quotas last week. could be more traffic hitting quantized variant that has higher cold-kv cost. :eyes:

alex: re-ran with `by(fallback_variant)` — p95 bump aligns with `variant=v2-q4` only on region eu-west. weird because total samplecount for that shard is small.

jin: small sample counts can still shift percentiles a lot if the tail changes. are we aggregating shards before quantile vs after? aggregation order matters.

maria: exactly. if we compute quantile per-shard then merge, result != global quantile. our dashboard default is per-shard quantile then weighted merge (old assumption). maybe that merge uses weight=samplecount which is noisy across tiny shards.

kevin: can we try `global_histogram_merge=true` for that rollup? quick A/B in console — toggle at the chart level to use global histogram before quantile. should be a config under rollup-engine -> merge-mode.

metrics-bot: deploy:service/rollup-engine v1.14.2 promoted by @ci-bot at 2024-04-10T08:05:12Z (no downtime).

alex: that deploy was earlier, yeah. but config change for merge-mode wasn't part of that.

maria: I pushed a quick dashboard variant that computes p50/p95/p99 using global merge (i.e., sum of buckets -> quantile). link: https://console.redwood/rows/xyz — toggled for the EU rollup.

kevin: preliminary: global-merge removes the 120ms step. so this is the aggregation artifact. p99 still same. p50 slightly lower.

jin: ok that suggests per-shard quantile-then-merge is unstable with low sample shards. we should: 1) change default for endpoint rollups with <500 samples to global-merge, 2) add an annotation in the UI explaining derivation, 3) surface samplecount in the sparkline tooltip.

alex: +1. can someone open a tiny UX ticket to add the derivation note? also we should document in runbook why p95 moves but p99 doesn't (sampling influence).

maria: filing now. ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENGPLAT-8421 — notes included and repro steps (how to force by toggling fallback weights).

kevin: I'll follow up with a telemetry change to add `merge_mode` metadata to exported rollups so offline consumers know how quantiles were derived.

jin: also consider a warning badge on charts when samplecount < 200. avoids frantic paging. :sweat_smile:

alex: love that. thanks y'all. i'll leave the dashboard in global-merge for 2 hours to watch any regressions and then revert if anything else pops up.

metrics-bot: alert: p95 for /v1/generate (eu-west) returned to baseline after global-merge enabled. 8:27 UTC.

deploy-bot: note: feature-flag `merge_mode_default` set to `global` for rollup-timeout experiment by @kevin (flag-id: ff-3312).

maria: closing loop: will add runbook blurb + UX ticket + telemetry change PR. thanks for the quick debug! :thumbsup:
